comparison.objective: Candidate calibrates a damper; record selects the sponge left of a cup and moves it to zone A while preserving distractors.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests precision tool use, adjustment, locking, and cycling; record tests relational perception and selective pick-and-place.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate uses explicit physical limits and repeated dynamic trials. Board record omits setup, scoring, zone tolerance, disturbance tolerance, and run limit.
comparison.reason: Relational object selection and placement are meaningfully different from mechanical tuning and stopping-response validation.
